UART Exported Functions

group UART_Exported_Functions

Functions

void UART_DeInit(UART_TypeDef *UARTx)

Deinitialize the selected UART peripheral registers to their default reset values(turn off UART clock).

Example usage 

void driver_uart_init(void)
{
   UART_DeInit(UART0);
}

参数:

UARTx -- [in] Select the UART peripheral. Refer to UART Declaration.

void UART_Init(UART_TypeDef *UARTx, UART_InitTypeDef *UART_InitStruct)

Initialize the selected UART peripheral according to the specified parameters in UART_InitStruct.

Example usage 

void driver_uart_init(void)
{
    UART_DeInit(UART0);

    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_UART0, APBPeriph_UART0_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    UART_InitTypeDef UART_InitStruct;
    UART_StructInit(&UART_InitStruct);
    UART_InitStruct.UART_Div         = 20;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_Ovsr        = 12;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_OvsrAdj     = 0x252;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_RxThdLevel  = 16;
   //Add other initialization parameters that need to be configured here.
    UART_Init(UART0, &UART_InitStruct);
}

参数:

  • UARTx -- [in] Select the UART peripheral. Refer to UART Declaration.

  • UART_InitStruct -- [in] Pointer to a UART_InitTypeDef structure which will be initialized.

void UART_StructInit(UART_InitTypeDef *UART_InitStruct)

Fill each UART_InitStruct member with its default value.

Example usage 

void driver_uart_init(void)
{
    UART_DeInit(UART0);

    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_UART0, APBPeriph_UART0_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    UART_InitTypeDef UART_InitStruct;
    UART_StructInit(&UART_InitStruct);
    UART_InitStruct.UART_Div         = 20;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_Ovsr        = 12;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_OvsrAdj     = 0x252;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_RxThdLevel  = 16;
    //Add other initialization parameters that need to be configured here.
    UART_Init(UART0, &UART_InitStruct);
}

void UART_MaskINTConfig(UART_TypeDef *UARTx, uint32_t UART_INT_MASK, FunctionalState NewState)

Mask or unmask the specified UART interrupt source.

Example usage 

void driver_uart_init(void)
{
    UART_DeInit(UART0);

    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_UART0, APBPeriph_UART0_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    UART_InitTypeDef UART_InitStruct;
    UART_StructInit(&UART_InitStruct);
    UART_InitStruct.UART_Div         = 20;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_Ovsr        = 12;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_OvsrAdj     = 0x252;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_RxThdLevel  = 16;
    //Add other initialization parameters that need to be configured here.
    UART_Init(UART0, &UART_InitStruct);

    UART_MaskINTConfig(UART0, UART_INT_MASK_RD_AVA, ENABLE);
    UART_INTConfig(UART0, UART_INT_RD_AVA, ENABLE);
    UART_MaskINTConfig(UART0, UART_INT_MASK_RD_AVA, DISABLE);
}

参数:

  • UARTx -- [in] Select the UART peripheral. Refer to UART Declaration.

  • UART_INT -- [in] Specify the UART interrupt source that to be mask or unmask. This parameter can be one of the following values, refer to UART Interrupts Mask.

    • UART_INT_MASK_RD_AVA: Mask INTCR(erbi).

    • UART_INT_MASK_FIFO_EMPTY: Mask INTCR(etbei).

    • UART_INT_MASK_LINE_STS: Mask INTCR(elsi).

    • UART_INT_MASK_MODEM_STS: Mask INTCR(edssi).

    • UART_INT_MASK_RX_BREAK: Mask rx break interrupt.

    • UART_INT_MASK_RX_IDLE: Mask rx break interrupt.

    • UART_INT_MASK_TX_DONE: Mask the interrupt tx done interrupt.

    • UART_INT_MASK_TX_THD: Mask tx fifo threshold interrupt.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the specified UART interrupt source. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • ENABLE: Mask the specified UART interrupt source.

    • DISABLE: Unmask the specified UART interrupt source.

void UART_INTConfig(UART_TypeDef *UARTx, uint32_t UART_IT, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable the specified UART interrupts.

Example usage 

void driver_uart_init(void)
{
    UART_DeInit(UART0);

    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_UART0, APBPeriph_UART0_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    UART_InitTypeDef UART_InitStruct;
    UART_StructInit(&UART_InitStruct);
    UART_InitStruct.UART_Div         = 20;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_Ovsr        = 12;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_OvsrAdj     = 0x252;
    UART_InitStruct.UART_RxThdLevel  = 16;
    //Add other initialization parameters that need to be configured here.
    UART_Init(UART0, &UART_InitStruct);

    UART_INTConfig(UART0, UART_INT_RD_AVA, ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • UARTx -- [in] Select the UART peripheral. Refer to UART Declaration.

  • UART_IT -- [in] Specify the UART interrupt source that to be enabled or disabled. This parameter can be any combination of the following values, refer to UART Interrupts.

    • UART_INT_RD_AVA: Rx data avaliable interrupt source.

    • UART_INT_TX_FIFO_EMPTY: Tx FIFO empty interrupt source.

    • UART_INT_RX_LINE_STS: Rx line status interrupt source.

    • UART_INT_MODEM_STS: Modem status interrupt source.

    • UART_INT_TX_DONE: Tx done interrupt source.

    • UART_INT_TX_THD: Tx threshold(FIFO data length <= thredhold) interrupt source.

    • UART_INT_RX_BREAK: Rx break signal interrupt source.

    • UART_INT_RX_IDLE: Rx bus ilde interrupt source.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the specified UART interrupt source. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • ENABLE: Enable the specified UART interrupt.

    • DISABLE: Disable the specified UART interrupt.

void UART_SetParams(UART_TypeDef *UARTx, uint16_t wordLen, uint16_t parity, uint16_t stopBits)

Set UART communication parameters.

Example usage 

void uart_demo(void)
{
    uint16_t word_len = UART_WORD_LENGTH_8BIT;
    uint16_t parity = UART_PARITY_NO_PARTY;
    uint16_t stop_bits = UART_STOP_BITS_1;
    UART_SetParams(UART0, wordLen, parity, stopBits);
}

参数:

  • UARTx -- [in] Select the UART peripheral. Refer to UART Declaration.

  • wordLen -- [in] Data width of the selected UART peripheral. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • UART_WORD_LENGTH_7BIT: 7-bit data length.

    • UART_WORD_LENGTH_8BIT: 8-bit data length.

  • parity -- [in] Parity of the selected UART peripheral. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • UART_STOP_BITS_1: 1-bit stop bit.

    • UART_STOP_BITS_2: 2-bit stop bit.

  • stopBits -- [in] Stop bit of the selected UART peripheral. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • UART_PARITY_NO_PARTY: No parity.

    • UART_PARITY_ODD: Odd parity.

    • UART_PARITY_EVEN: Even parity.

FlagStatus UART_GetFlagStatus(UART_TypeDef *UARTx, uint32_t UART_FLAG)

Check whether the specified UART flag is set.

Example usage 

void uart_senddata_continuous(UART_TypeDef *UARTx, const uint8_t *pSend_Buf, uint16_t vCount)
{
    uint8_t count;

    while (vCount / UART_TX_FIFO_SIZE > 0)
    {
        while (UART_GetFlagStatus(UARTx, UART_FLAG_TX_FIFO_EMPTY) == 0);
        for (count = UART_TX_FIFO_SIZE; count > 0; count--)
        {
            UARTx->UART_RBR_THR = *pSend_Buf++;
        }
        vCount -= UART_TX_FIFO_SIZE;
    }

    while (UART_GetFlagStatus(UARTx, UART_FLAG_TX_FIFO_EMPTY) == 0);
    while (vCount--)
    {
        UARTx->UART_RBR_THR = *pSend_Buf++;
    }
}

参数:

  • UARTx -- [in] Select the UART peripheral. Refer to UART Declaration.

  • UART_FLAG -- [in] Specify UART flag to check. This parameter can be one of the following values, refer to UART Flag.

    • UART_FLAG_RX_DATA_AVA: Rx data is avaliable.

    • UART_FLAG_RX_OVERRUN: Rx FIFO overrun.

    • UART_FLAG_RX_PARITY_ERR: Rx parity error.

    • UART_FLAG_RX_FRAME_ERR: Rx frame error.

    • UART_FLAG_RX_BREAK_ERR: Rx break error.

    • UART_FLAG_TX_FIFO_EMPTY: Tx Holding Register or Tx FIFO empty

    • UART_FLAG_TX_EMPTY: Tx FIFO and Tx shift register are both empty.

    • UART_FLAG_RX_FIFO_ERR: Rx FIFO error.

    • UART_FLAG_RX_IDLE: Rx idle.

    • UART_FLAG_TX_DONE: Tx waveform done & TX_FIFO_EMPTY = 1.

    • UART_FLAG_TX_THD: TX_FIFO_LEVEL<=txfifo_trigger_level.

返回:

New status of UART flag.

  • SET: The specified UART flag bit is set.

  • RESET: The specified flag is not set.

uint16_t UART_GetIID(UART_TypeDef *UARTx)

Get the interrupt identifier of the selected UART peripheral.

Example usage 

void UART0_Handler()
{
    uint16_t rx_len = 0;
    uint8_t uart_rev_data[32];

    //Get interrupt ID.
    uint32_t int_status = UART_GetIID(UART0);

    //Disable interrupt.
    UART_INTConfig(UART0, UART_INT_RD_AVA, DISABLE);

    if (UART_GetFlagStatus(UART0, UART_FLAG_RX_IDLE) == SET)
    {
        UART_INTConfig(UART0, UART_INT_RX_IDLE, DISABLE);
        //Add user code here.
        UART_ClearRxFIFO(UART0);
        UART_INTConfig(UART0, UART_INT_RX_IDLE, ENABLE);
    }

}

参数:

UARTx -- [in] Select the UART peripheral. Refer to UART Declaration.

返回:

The interrupt identifier value. This return value can be one or a combination of the following:

  • UART_INT_ID_LINE_STATUS: Rx line status interrupt ID.

  • UART_INT_ID_RX_LEVEL_REACH: Rx data available or trigger level reached interrupt ID.

  • UART_INT_ID_RX_TIMEOUT: Rx FIFO data timeout interrupt ID.

  • UART_INT_ID_TX_FIFO_EMPTY: Tx FIFO empty interrupt ID.

  • UART_INT_ID_MODEM_STATUS: Modem status interrupt ID.
